description: Every map into an empty codomain is bijective: the existence of such a map forces its domain to be empty too. In particular, the map \(\varnothing\to\varnothing\) is bijective.
signature: Function.Bijective.of_isEmpty.{u_1, u_2} {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} (f : α → β) [IsEmpty β] : Function.Bijective f
